garbage-collection-algorithm.name: Epsilon GC
garbage-collection-algorithm.why: HotSpot's no-op garbage collector that allocates without reclaiming memory

garbage-collection-algorithm.name: G1 GC
garbage-collection-algorithm.why: HotSpot's Garbage-First regionalized, generational, mostly-concurrent collector

garbage-collection-algorithm.name: ZGC
garbage-collection-algorithm.why: HotSpot's scalable low-latency concurrent collector using colored pointers

garbage-collection-algorithm.name: accurate garbage collection
garbage-collection-algorithm.why: GC scheme with exact type/stack-map knowledge of all live references

garbage-collection-algorithm.name: copying collector

garbage-collection-algorithm.name: conservative garbage collection
